lines.zh: 我沿着暖海的沙底慢慢爬。
lines.en: I crawl slowly over warm-sea sand.

lines.zh: 我背着壳挪动，身后留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: I move with my shell, leaving a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我滚半圈，再伸出触手往前划。
lines.en: I roll half a turn, then reach out tentacles to pull forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚走，壳上蹭了颜色。
lines.en: I pass close to coral and my shell picks up its color.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我就顺着它滑一段。
lines.en: The current pushes and I glide with it a while.

lines.zh: 我一路捡着沙里的碎壳走。
lines.en: I go along picking shell bits from the sand.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，壳很沉，可我不着急。
lines.en: I move slowly; the shell is heavy but I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我绕过海葵，触手收得紧紧的。
lines.en: I round the anemone with tentacles drawn in tight.

lines.zh: 我在浅水区爬，光在壳上晃。
lines.en: I crawl in the shallows, light wavering on my shell.

lines.zh: 我滚过石头，壳磕出闷响。
lines.en: I roll over a rock and my shell knocks dully.

lines.zh: 我沿着海草边缘走，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I follow the seagrass edge, where there is food.

lines.zh: 我停下，把触手全缩回壳里。
lines.en: I stop and draw every tentacle into my shell.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流漂，脚不太用力。
lines.en: I drift on the warm current, barely using my feet.

lines.zh: 我走到你的影子里，那里凉。
lines.en: I move into your shadow, which is cooler.

lines.zh: 我把壳侧过来，从石缝里滚过去。
lines.en: I tip my shell sideways and roll through the gap.

lines.zh: 触手一寸寸撑地，把壳抬起来。
lines.en: Tentacles push the ground inch by inch, lifting my shell.

lines.zh: 我半开着壳，触手在水里轻轻摆。
lines.en: My shell half open, tentacles sway gently in the water.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串小气泡，看它们往上跑。
lines.en: I release a string of bubbles and watch them rise.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，壳里发出很轻的响。
lines.en: I lie on the sand and something ticks softly inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我把触手卷起来，像收好的绳。
lines.en: I coil my tentacles like rope put away.

lines.zh: 水从我的鳃边过，很暖。
lines.en: Water passes my gills, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把我推去别处。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to push me elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我用触手摸沙，摸到一粒光滑的。
lines.en: I feel through the sand and find one smooth grain.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转壳，让开口朝着光。
lines.en: I turn my shell slowly until the opening faces the light.

lines.zh: 我安静得像一块带花纹的石头。
lines.en: I am as still as a patterned stone.

lines.zh: 有小鱼啄我的壳，我没有赶它。
lines.en: A small fish pecks my shell and I do not shoo it.

lines.zh: 我把身体往壳里缩了一寸。
lines.en: I draw myself an inch deeper into the shell.

lines.zh: 我数着从头顶游过的鱼影。
lines.en: I count the fish shadows passing overhead.

lines.zh: 我把壳口对着暖流，让水灌进来。
lines.en: I face my shell opening into the current and let water pour in.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，这样也很好。
lines.en: I do nothing at all, and that is fine.

lines.zh: 我从壳口探出触手，先闻你。
lines.en: I put out a tentacle and scent you first.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，我把壳转正对着你。
lines.en: You dive down and I turn my shell square to you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚蹼，那里会动。
lines.en: I watch your flippers, which keep moving.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就把触手收一半。
lines.en: As you near, I pull half my tentacles in.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，眼睛在触手底下。
lines.en: I watch you long, my eyes beneath the tentacles.

lines.zh: 你吐的气泡吓了我一下。
lines.en: Your bubbles startle me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢伸出最长的那根触手。
lines.en: I extend my longest tentacle slowly.

lines.zh: 我歪着壳，像在衡量你有多大。
lines.en: I tilt my shell as if sizing you up.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我往沙里压了压。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I press into the sand.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，海水替我眨。
lines.en: I do not blink; the sea blinks for me.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一道，里面透进光。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell and light gets in.

lines.zh: 我缩得很快，触手全塞进去了。
lines.en: I retract fast, every tentacle stuffed inside.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会吐泡泡，止不住。
lines.en: In pain I release bubbles and cannot stop.

lines.zh: 这一下打碎了我壳口的一角。
lines.en: That broke a corner off my shell opening.

lines.zh: 我滚开了，沙上留着碎壳。
lines.en: I roll away, leaving shell bits in the sand.

lines.zh: 我掉了一根触手，它还在动。
lines.en: I lose a tentacle and it keeps moving.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的摩擦声，像石头。
lines.en: I make a low grinding sound, like stone.

lines.zh: 别打壳，那是我全部的家。
lines.en: Not the shell; it is my entire home.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把裂口转到看不见的一侧。
lines.en: I slowly turn the crack to the hidden side.

lines.zh: 我疼得缩了半天，才敢再伸出来。
lines.en: I stay withdrawn a long while before daring to reach out.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼味，顺着水飘过来了。
lines.en: The fish smell in your hand drifts over with the water.

lines.zh: 我伸出触手，够了够，还差一点。
lines.en: I stretch a tentacle, almost, not quite.

lines.zh: 是海带吗？我壳里还留着上次的味道。
lines.en: Kelp? The taste of last time lingers in my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝你滚，壳在沙上拖。
lines.en: I roll toward you, shell dragging through sand.

lines.zh: 你把东西沉下来，我就过去。
lines.en: Lower it and I will come.

lines.zh: 我不争抢，只等你自己松开。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 这点味道够我从礁石那边爬过来。
lines.en: That scent was enough to bring me from the reef.

lines.zh: 我卷住食物，往壳里拖。
lines.en: I wrap the food and drag it into my shell.

lines.zh: 我吃东西很慢，壳里全是响。
lines.en: I eat slowly and my shell is full of noise.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我还跟着你，怕你还有。
lines.en: Done eating, I still follow in case you have more.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的壳，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: You kick my shell and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上你，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: My shell hits you with a muffled knock.

lines.zh: 我被水推到你身上，触手乱抓。
lines.en: Water shoves me against you and my tentacles grab wildly.

lines.zh: 别踩，壳裂了我就没地方住。
lines.en: Do not step there; a cracked shell leaves me homeless.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你身上沾了沙。
lines.en: We collide and sand sticks to you.

lines.zh: 我缩回壳里，只留一条缝看你走。
lines.en: I shrink into my shell and wait for you to leave.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我翻了，我慢慢翻回来。
lines.en: The knock flips me and I slowly right myself.

lines.zh: 你扶了我一下，我没有谢你。
lines.en: You steady me and I do not thank you.

lines.zh: 我的触手碰到你的腿，缩得很快。
lines.en: My tentacle touches your leg and snaps back fast.

lines.zh: 我滚到你脚边，就赖着不动了。
lines.en: I roll to your feet and refuse to move.

lines.zh: 我把壳口对着另一只，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I face my shell opening toward another and inch closer.

lines.zh: 我们用触手互相碰，碰得很轻。
lines.en: We touch tentacles, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我跟着她沿着礁石滚了一圈。
lines.en: I roll a full circuit of the reef after her.

lines.zh: 我把最好的沙底让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴在暖流里，壳贴着壳。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the warm current, shells touching.

lines.zh: 我伸出触手，替她清掉壳上的藻。
lines.en: I reach out and clear the algae from her shell.

lines.zh: 她滚远了，我又慢慢追上去。
lines.en: She rolls away and I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 我们交换了壳口的水，那就算答应。
lines.en: We trade water at our shell mouths, and that is a yes.

lines.zh: 我在她壳边守了一整夜。
lines.en: I kept watch beside her shell all night.

lines.zh: 我们各自背着壳，却走同一条路。
lines.en: We carry separate shells yet travel the same path.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷起一片碎壳，又掉了。
lines.en: I curl a tentacle around a shell shard and drop it.

lines.zh: 那块亮石头很沉，我拖了两步。
lines.en: That bright stone is heavy; I drag it two steps.

lines.zh: 我把海草塞进壳缝，算是收藏。
lines.en: I stuff seagrass into a shell seam as a collection.

lines.zh: 我试着抱起整只海星，抱不住。
lines.en: I try to lift a whole starfish and fail.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只是为了塞住壳口。
lines.en: I pick things up only to plug my shell opening.

lines.zh: 我把碎屑拨到一边，露出沙。
lines.en: I sweep the debris aside and uncover sand.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉下来，我碰了碰。
lines.en: What you dropped sinks and I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我卷起一根骨刺，转了两圈。
lines.en: I curl around a bone spur and turn it twice.

lines.zh: 我带走的是壳片，留下的也是壳片。
lines.en: I take shell pieces and leave shell pieces.

lines.zh: 我拿了不属于我的东西，然后忘了。
lines.en: I take what is not mine, then forget it.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我把触手全伸出来。
lines.en: Blood is in the water and every tentacle comes out.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，壳转了半圈。
lines.en: Something moves there and my shell swings half around.

lines.zh: 我看见一群小鱼，可它们太快。
lines.en: I see a school of small fish, but they are too quick.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那块石头下的阴影。
lines.en: I have fixed on the shadow under that rock.

lines.zh: 你的动作变慢了，我注意到了。
lines.en: Your movements slowed and I noticed.

lines.zh: 我把壳压低，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I lower my shell and edge closer.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙里翻，我记住了位置。
lines.en: Something turns in the sand; I marked the place.

lines.zh: 我朝亮的地方爬，那里常有吃的。
lines.en: I crawl toward brightness, where food usually is.

lines.zh: 我找到一个壳口，正好够我钻。
lines.en: I find a shell opening just wide enough.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，因为你一直在原地。
lines.en: I have chosen you because you keep standing still.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滚，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I roll along the sand, as silent as I can.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，壳口对着它。
lines.en: I come around behind it with my shell opening aimed.

lines.zh: 我伸出触手试探，碰到就收。
lines.en: I probe with a tentacle and pull back on contact.

lines.zh: 我在等它离开石头。
lines.en: I wait for it to leave the rock.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，壳变成一块石头。
lines.en: I flatten down until my shell is just another stone.

lines.zh: 我一点一点挪，每次只挪一点。
lines.en: I creep, one small shift at a time.

lines.zh: 水流变了，我顺着它靠近。
lines.en: The current shifted and I ride it closer.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，我的壳颜色刚好。
lines.en: It has not noticed; my shell color fits here.

lines.zh: 我把触手张开，准备好卷。
lines.en: I spread my tentacles, ready to wrap.

lines.zh: 我停在一步之外，先看它怎么动。
lines.en: I stop one step short and watch it move first.

lines.zh: 我用壳撞它，然后立刻缩回去。
lines.en: I ram it with my shell, then pull straight back.

lines.zh: 我咬它一口，齿在触手中间。
lines.en: I bite it, teeth set among my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷住它，往礁石上拖。
lines.en: I wrap it in tentacles and drag it toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我的攻击很慢，可卷上就不放。
lines.en: My attack is slow, but once wrapped I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，壳磕出一声闷响。
lines.en: I slam forward and my shell gives a dull knock.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我掉了几根触手尖。
lines.en: It breaks free and I lose a few tentacle tips.

lines.zh: 我咬完就往沙里钻。
lines.en: After biting, I burrow into the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下没什么力气，但我努力了。
lines.en: It was not strong, but I tried.

lines.zh: 我用壳边刮它，留下白痕。
lines.en: I scrape it with my shell rim and leave a white mark.

lines.zh: 我打不过就跑，滚得比谁都快。
lines.en: If I cannot win I flee, rolling faster than anyone.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of the egg with a shell still soft.

lines.zh: 我第一次滚下礁石，摔进沙里。
lines.en: My first roll off the reef lands me in sand.

lines.zh: 暖流把我带到这片海，我就留下了。
lines.en: The warm current brought me to this sea and I stayed.

lines.zh: 我出生时壳只有指甲大。
lines.en: My shell was only a fingernail wide at birth.

lines.zh: 我顶着一身黏水，慢慢爬向光。
lines.en: Slick with fluid, I crawl slowly toward light.

lines.zh: 我第一口吃的是海草上的藻。
lines.en: My first meal was algae off seagrass.

lines.zh: 我从深水浮上来，壳里还有冷。
lines.en: I surface from deep water with cold still in my shell.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚缝里长大，那里很挤。
lines.en: I grew in a coral crevice, and it was cramped.

lines.zh: 我落下时，沙扬了一片。
lines.en: When I landed, sand billowed up.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，满眼都是晃动的蓝。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a world of shifting blue.

lines.zh: 热水烫过壳，我第一次觉得海会烧。
lines.en: Hot water scalds my shell and for once the sea feels like it burns.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上摔下去，壳磕掉一块。
lines.en: I fall from the reef and a chunk breaks off my shell.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可这次水进得太深。
lines.en: I already live in water, but this time it goes too deep.

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙掀起来，我的壳埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast throws up sand and half-buries my shell.

lines.zh: 箭擦过壳边，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shell rim and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 药水让水变味，我的触手全缩了。
lines.en: The potion sours the water and all my tentacles retract.

lines.zh: 沙里没有吃的，我的壳都轻了。
lines.en: No food in the sand and my shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 雷电进水，我整个人麻得卷起来。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and I curl up numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的触手不知道往哪伸。
lines.en: There is no water here and my tentacles do not know where to reach.
